title: CHAF1A identified as a candidate biomarker and potential therapeutic target in Burkitt lymphoma through integrated bioinformatics and histopathological analysis.
snippet: Burkitt lymphoma (BL) is a highly aggressive malignancy with limited effective treatments due to toxicity/resistance. Identifying and prioritizing candidate biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets from complex transcriptomic data, ahead of functional validation, remains a major unmet need. title: Cancer associated fibroblast-T cell crosstalk promotes purinergic synthesis in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
snippet: The most abundant stromal cells of the tumor microenvironment (TME), cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), inhibit the cytotoxic T cell response in solid tumors. CD39 and CD73 together deplete extracellular ATP in the TME to produce adenosine, which can promote tumor immune evasion.
